To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel incremental graph pattern based node matching method, INC GPN M, to incrementally maintain and deliver the node matching result in the data graph w.r.t. to the updates of the pattern graph.

we proposed an efficient method INC GPNM for delivering node matching results based the updates of GP, and INC GPNM has much better efficiency than the state of the arts GPNM methods in real world graphs.
we propose a novel incremental graph pattern based node matching method to efficiently deliver node matching query results based on the updates of GP or GD.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the incremental graph pattern based node matching problem, which is a fundamental and important problem in graph matching and graph data analysis.
a novel incremental GPNM approach, which can incrementally deliver node matching results with high efficiency.
the problem of incremental graph pattern based node matching in the context of graph data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our method is the first to efficiently deliver node matching result based on the updated graph pattern and the updated data graph.
INC GPNM is the first GPNM method that can efficiently process the incremental updates of GP and/or GD.
the proposed INCremental GPMN method can efficiently deliver the matching results based on an updated GP and GD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel GPNM method to deliver node matching results efficiently based on the incremental updates of GP and updated GD.
we provide a new perspective to incrementally deliver the node matching result in GPNM, which can be extended for many real applications.
INC GPNM is the first incremental method to efficiently deliver GPNM results in a data graph with the updates of both a pattern graph and the data graph.
The main takeaway from our work is that

INC GPNM is the first method that can incrementally deliver node matching results based the updates of both GP and GD, while the existing GPN M methods need to perform the whole GPNM process from scratch to deliver node matching results.
INC GPNM is a novel method that can efficiently deliver node matches based on the updated data graphs.
INC GPNM is the first incremental GPNM method that can deliver the matching results based on updated GP and GD efficiently.
